attributes.action: Call a General Election. The country did not elect Andy Burnham.
attributes.background: A general election needs to be held as when Rishi Sunak became Prime Minister the Labour Party particularly Andy Burnham called for a general election.  Should he not practise what he preaches?

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
